title: Cumi Silicone Carbide Combination Stone No 109
description: Cumi Silicone Carbide Combination Stone No 109 is a dual-purpose sharpening stone designed for efficient tool maintenance. Featuring a coarse side for rapid edge restoration and a fine side for precision finishing, this combination stone delivers professional results on chisels, plane blades, knives, and other cutting tools. The silicon carbide construction ensures durability and consistent performance across repeated use. Compact and portable, it's ideal for workshops, job sites, and home use. Simply soak briefly in water before use and maintain with regular cleaning for long-lasting reliability. Perfect for craftspeople and professionals who demand quality sharpening in a single, economical tool.
